name: codex-mobile-mail-bridge
description: Email-based mobile supervision and follow-up command loop for local Codex work.

interface.shortDescription: Send local Codex work reports by email and accept safe mobile follow-up instructions.
interface.longDescription: Codex Mobile Mail Bridge installs a local email bridge that sends computer-side Codex work reports to configured recipients and polls a mailbox for whitelisted follow-up instructions tagged with [codex].
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me configure and run the Codex Mobile Mail Bridge.
